## Branch state

4 commits on top of main (post-pull from origin/main `4e8c971`):
1. `5aa903e` — Tallis RED for #67 (env-import mock; 2 failing specs)

## Hot RED triggers to verify

- **#67:** `ENTU_DB` no longer hardcoded anywhere in `src/lib/auth/userStore.ts`. All references use `PUBLIC_ENTU_DB` from `$env/static/public`. `.env.example` documents `PUBLIC_ENTU_DB=polyphony` (Byrd reports already present).
- **#68:** Both `_owner`-only and member-only paths covered by specs (you flagged this at intro). Dedupe priority correct (member-derived role wins, founder-only gets `'owner'`). The `fetchMock.mock.calls` assertion in Tallis's spec binds Byrd to actually fire the owner query — verify it's a parallel `Promise.all` fetch, not serialized.
- **Path C arch rules:** No server imports in client; no direct `https://entu.app` calls from `.svelte` (this work is all in `src/lib/auth/`, browser-side). Trailer hygiene: no `Co-authored-by:` lines in either Byrd commit body.
- **Diff-shape post-merge** (L110): your standard `git log --oneline branch..main` first check — main is at `4e8c971` (Pérotin) + `c2c5029` (your own scratchpad). The feature branch should NOT contain `c2c5029` since you committed it after the branch was created. Verify the squash will pick up your scratchpad on main's side, not lose it.

## Side flag — Playwright count

Byrd reports 12 pre-existing Playwright failures, but session-22 seed said 11 (CHORE-C scope, unchanged). Either: (a) miscounted before, (b) a new failure landed between session-22 close and today, (c) one of these 4 commits flipped one — unlikely since Playwright doesn't import `userStore.ts` AFAIK but worth a 30-second sanity check on the delta. If you can confirm "12 = 11 prior + 1 unrelated to this branch," noting it in YELLOW is fine. If the delta IS one of these commits, that's RED.

## Output

Standard verdict — RED / YELLOW / GREEN with rationale. If GREEN, Josquin merges (Task #8). If YELLOW with non-blocking notes, Josquin merges and we file follow-ups. If RED, work routes back to Tallis (new tests) or Byrd (fix).
